stemMd: A diver descends from 2 m to 5 m below a freshwater surface. Taking density 1000 kg/m cubed and g=10 m/s squared, by how much does hydrostatic pressure increase?
explanationMd: The pressure change is density times g times depth change: 1000 times 10 times (5−2)=30000 Pa. Atmospheric pressure cancels when taking the difference.

distractorRationale.b: This is gauge pressure at the final depth, not the increase.
distractorRationale.c: This adds depths rather than taking the difference.
distractorRationale.e: This is gauge pressure at the initial depth.
